An accepted operation can later fail through Operation.error; HTTP acceptance is not hardware success.

202.description: Command accepted for asynchronous execution. Follow Location to getOperation until succeeded, failed or cancelled; inspect final_output and restore_pending.

Location.description: Relative URL /api/v1/operations/{operationId} for polling in this node boot.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Configured physical device ID on this node. Discover IDs with listDevices; do not use a model name unless it is the configured ID.

parameters.name: X-Lab-Lease
parameters.description: Active lease ID covering this physical device. Components share ownership; heartbeats must continue while commands are pending.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key per logical mutation (1..96 characters). Repeating the same method/path/semantic JSON body within this boot returns the existing operation; reusing it for different content returns 409. Retention is bounded. After an uncertain timeout or reboot, inspect state and STOP as needed instead of replaying ON.

requestBody.description: JSON request with the fields documented by the referenced schema. Unknown properties are rejected; use {} for an empty StopRequest.

put.description:
Set the source current limit in A without enabling output. The RD60xx driver uses Modbus RTU echo plus fresh register readback, verifies instrument identity and enforces 0.01 A steps and configured limits. Prefer setComponentCurrent for new scripts. Real RD6024 commissioning remains open; optional PSU Bluetooth is not an enabled runtime transport.

Returns 202 with an Operation and Location, not an instrument acknowledgement. Keep the lease alive where required and poll until terminal. Bounded device retries/readback recovery run on the bridge; callers receive a terminal failure when recovery is exhausted. Do not automatically replay an uncertain mutation.

Set the source voltage in V without enabling output. The RD60xx driver uses verified Modbus RTU register writes, 0.01 V steps and configured limits. Prefer setComponentVoltage for new scripts. Readback confirms the setpoint, not the actual terminal voltage under load. Real hardware commissioning remains open.

Returns 202 with an Operation and Location, not an instrument acknowledgement. Keep the lease alive where required and poll until terminal. Bounded device retries/readback recovery run on the bridge; callers receive a terminal failure when recovery is exhausted. Do not automatically replay an uncertain mutation.
